summary: Links tab actions moved from the toolbar buttons into a right-click context menu on the links table, and the table now draws its last row border.
details: Refresh and Break are on the table context menu; right-clicking inside a selection keeps it, and right-clicking an unselected row selects that row first.
The table fills the whole tab now that the toolbar is gone, and the final row keeps its bottom border instead of ending without one.
Applies to both the DFM and Dataset Viewer Links tabs.
